evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting upward during growth: 3.03 → 3.075 → 3.18 → 3.199 → 3.275 Torr at constant Ar 100 sccm
Flow steady at setpoint 100 sccm, so pressure rise is not from flow change
Temperature holds 750 °C at setpoint with stable heater power ~44%
O2 sensor not installed, so air ingress / leak cannot be checked directly

args.missing_evidence: O2 exhaust reading (not installed) or a pressure response test — e.g. briefly step Ar flow or isolate the tube to distinguish a downstream exhaust restriction from a leak; also normal-run reference band for growth-stage pressure.
